tasks.label: Build current file (auto)
args: if [[ "${fileExtname}" == ".c" ]]; then gcc -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 -g "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/main"; elif [[ "${fileExtname}" == ".cpp" || "${fileExtname}" == ".cc" || "${fileExtname}" == ".cxx" ]]; then g++ -Wall -Wextra -std=c++17 -g "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/main"; else echo "Unsupported file type: ${fileExtname}"; exit 1; fi
tasks.detail: Kompiliert die aktuell geöffnete C- oder C++-Datei automatisch.
